title: Local Students from International Baccalaureate Diploma and Integrated Programmes Admitted to Nursing Diploma or Degree Courses
what_it_is: Local Students from International Baccalaureate Diploma and Integrated Programmes Admitted to Nursing Diploma or Degree Courses

sections.label: IBDP and IP nursing admissions
sections.summary: Five IBDP and IP students were admitted to NYP and NP nursing diploma programmes in the past three years, with IHLs assessing applicants holistically.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health whether the Ministry has data on the number of students from the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme (IBDP) and the Integrated Programme (IP) who have been admitted to diploma in nursing or degree in nursing programmes at local Institutes of Higher Learning in the past three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: There were five students from the IBDP and IP admitted to Nanyang Polytechnic (NYP)’s and Ngee Ann Polytechnic (NP)’s Nursing diploma programmes, where most entered after completing Year 4 of their IB or IP studies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Our Institutes of Higher Learning (IHLs) will assess all applicants for nursing courses holistically, taking into account both academic performance and course fit.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For IBDP or IP students who are keen on nursing as a career, we encourage them to apply for admission to polytechnic Nursing diploma programmes on the basis of Year 4 grades, and the NUS Nursing degree programme on the basis of Year 6 grades.

sections.label: Growing and retaining nursing manpower
sections.summary: The Ministry is growing nursing manpower, tracking numbers, working with schools and healthcare institutions, and reviewing remuneration and work streams.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Indeed, this is something close to our hearts and it is of concern.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We are trying to grow the manpower and we are on track on building the numbers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The numbers are small now, but we are encouraging movements from the different tracks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We are tracking the numbers from institutions to understand why there may be leakage or why people drop off from the courses and do 	not enter the profession.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We are working with schools and the healthcare institutions to ensure smooth transition, so that after they graduate, they enter into the profession.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: To facilitate entry into the profession, we are also reviewing the remuneration framework to ensure that the profession remains attractive.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: There are various work streams to look into how we can improve the profession, increase its stature as well as improve the work environments, so that overall, there is attraction to this profession.
